integrity: Analytic proof for every integer k>=2; reproducible exact finite checker for k=2..8 corroborates but does not substitute for the proof. Facet classification and finite metric free-space duality are credited to prior literature.
scientific_limitations: Only real unweighted complete multipartite graphs with all part sizes exactly two; uniqueness asserted only among invariant optimal quadratic-form ratios; no weighted, general-part-size or complex extension proved; a previously unpublished equivalent statement could exist.
title: Exact Hilbert distortion of cocktail-party transportation spaces
